slots.body: Hover for details

examples.label: Help hint beside a settings label
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-tooltip" site="Global" id="tooltip-api-key-help" position="right" width="large" text_position="left"> <:trigger> API key <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-question-mark-circle" class="size-4 opacity-70" /> <:content>Found under Settings, Developers. Rotating the key signs out every connected app.

examples.label: Inline glossary term inside body copy
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-tooltip" site="Global" id="tooltip-inline-ttl" inline={true} position="top" width="large"> <:trigger> TTL <:content>Time to live: how long an edge server may serve a cached copy before asking your origin again.

examples.label: Icon-only toolbar button with its label
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-tooltip" site="Global" id="tooltip-toolbar-delete" position="bottom">
  <:trigger>
    <button type="button" aria-label="Delete selection" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center size-9 rounded-md border border-black/10 dark:border-white/15">
      <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-trash" class="size-4" />
    </button>
  </:trigger>
  <:content>Delete selection</:content>
</.component>

examples.label: Clickable tooltip holding a value you can select and copy
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-tooltip" site="Global" id="tooltip-webhook-secret" clickable={true} hide_delay={800} position="top" width="large" text_position="left"> <:trigger> Signing secret <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-information-circle" class="size-4 opacity-70" /> <:content> Every webhook body is signed with this secret. Keep the pointer inside the tooltip to select it. whsec_8f2b41d0c7e94a55
